scope: Fastest archived configuration per implementation at the stated shape and tile; not a synchronized benchmark or claim about untested implementations.
statistic: Archived warmed full-stage mean latency, not minimum individual sample.
notes: ComfyUI and TensorRT references are historical; versions, inputs, software stacks, batching, precision and background GPU load differ.
No cross-experiment percentage speedups are inferred from these records.
PyOpt encode and decode results use different modes; their latencies must not be added as a measured combined configuration.
Previous PyOpt releases and slower configurations are excluded from the comparison charts; retained in the README iteration section and historical reports.
FP16-only PyOpt decode (10.923379s) is reported separately in the mode table, not as a second PyOpt bar in the fastest-configuration charts.
Current PyOpt decode is the warmed full-decode mean from six candidate runs in three ABBA/BAAB blocks, not a minimum sample; baseline 6.640226318359375s, candidate 6.508536539713542s.

For the decoder FFN comparison, benchmark-only generated-global bindings reuse the original normalization schedules for baseline and candidate. No run observer is active during timed calls. Independent default recompilations can select different reduction schedules and are not claimed bitwise equal.
